english.title: Leave a vehicle unattended and fail to set the handbrake at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be left unattended at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) on a road to which the road traffic enactments do not apply at Stansted Airport London without the parking brake or restraining device with which the vehicle was equipped being properly engaged
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(5) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
